violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. NO CFM ONSITE DURING INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. PIC UNDERSTANDS A CFM MUST BE ONSITE DURING ALL HOURS OF FOOD OPERATION. PIC ONSITE HAS FINISHED PREP COURSE BUT NEEDS TO SCHEDULE EXAM. PLEASE ENSURE CORRECTION BY THE TIME OF THE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION TO PREVENT ENFORCEMENT ACTION.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED SMALL YOGURT CUPS AT 46-47F IN SMALL COUNTER-TOP COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC UNDERSTANDS COLD HOLDING FOODS SHOULD BE KEPT AT 41F OR BELOW. YOGURTS WERE MOVED TO ANOTHER COOLER DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Durable Materials
violations.observation: OBSERVED NON-NSF APPROVED (OR EQUIVALENT) COUNTER-TOP COOLER AT 41F DURING INSPECTION (WITH EHS THERMOMETER). OBSERVED YOGURT IN COOLER NOT PROPERLY COLD HOLDING.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be resistant to pitting, chipping, crazing, scratching, scoring, distortion, and decomposition. PIC UNDERSTANDS THIS COOLER SHOULD BE REMOVED AS IT IS NOT NSF-APPROVED OR EQUIVALENT. PLEASE REMOVE FROM THE ESTABLISHMENT BY THE TIME OF THE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: QUATERNARY AMMONIA TEST KIT ONSITE IS EXPIRED.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a NEW QUATERNARY AMMONIA test kit.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. FOOD ESTABLISHMENT EMPLOYEE ONSITE HAS A CERTIFIED FOOD HANDLER CERTIFICATION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. PLEASE ENSURE A CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER IS ONSITE DURING ALL HOURS OF FOOD OPERATION. CERTIFIED FOOD HANDLER HAS TAKEN THE FIRST COURSE FOR THE CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER CLASS, BUT SHOULD TAKE THE EXAM AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.
